claims.claim: The Torsey Island clinic holds its monthly immunization clinic on Thursday 13 August 2026 starting at 9:00 AM, run by nurse Maeve Quinlan.
After the July session the clinic holds zero doses of the pediatric vaccines used at the immunization clinic, and no other facility on the island stocks them.
claims.source: Clinic stock ledger and island pharmacy formulary

claims.claim: Quinlan placed the clinic's restock order for 100 pediatric vaccine doses with Penhallow Medical Supply at 9:00 AM on Monday 10 August.
Penhallow's practice for cold-chain orders placed before noon is to have them picked, packed in validated coolers, and ready for carrier handoff by 8:00 AM the next business day.

The Torsey Island Ferry accepts refrigerated cargo only on its Monday, Wednesday, and Friday 7:30 AM sailings, with cold cargo checked in at the mainland terminal cold room by 6:30 AM on the sailing day.
Penhallow's driver delivers cold-chain shipments to the ferry terminal cold room by 6:00 AM on sailing days.
The marine forecast office issued a gale warning at 1:05 PM on Tuesday 11 August for the Torsey passage, in effect from 6:00 AM Wednesday 12 August to 3:00 AM Thursday 13 August.
The Torsey Island Ferry Company announced at 4:00 PM on Tuesday 11 August that all Wednesday 12 August sailings are cancelled because of the gale warning.

Torsey Island has no airstrip, the ferry is the only carrier serving the island with validated refrigerated storage, and Penhallow's cold-chain policy permits handoff only to carriers with such storage.
claims.source: County transport register and Penhallow cold-chain policy

claims.claim: The crossing takes 55 minutes, and the clinic's courier meets cargo sailings at the island dock to carry cold-chain deliveries straight to the clinic.
claims.source: Ferry timetable and clinic logistics note
